title: 14-jähriger E-Scooter-Fahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Beamter setzt DEIG ein

extraction.summaryEn: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider fled a speed check on Müggelheimer Damm, crashed, and was hit by a police taser (DEIG) during the foot pursuit. The boy was treated by paramedics as an outpatient and released to his father.
